system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"my Spotify has deleted all of my library for the third time this month. I pay for premium and have followed all the troubleshooting on your website :( help please"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! That sounds frustrating! Can you let us know if you can still see your playlists? Keep us posted! /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply lacks empathy and solution; needs reassurance and next steps for troubleshooting."}
